mapper.select: SELECT id, menu_id AS menuId, permission_key AS permissionKey, permission_code AS permissionCode, title_key AS titleKey, sort_order AS sortOrder, status, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_permission ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_role_permission WHERE permission_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE id = #{id} AND menu_type IN ('CATALOG','MENU') AND status = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_menu WHERE auth_code = #{code}
SELECT id FROM sys_role WHERE role_code = 'super_admin' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_permission SET menu_id = #{menuId}, title_key = #{title}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
